title: WordTwiq — a daily twin-word puzzle I made with Codex. Would love some feedback!
author: Fabulous_Property452
selftext:
Hey everyone! I recently built a daily word game called WordTwiq with the help of GPT 6 Astra in Codex, and I'd love some feedback on it. I came up with the twin-word idea and used Codex to help build and refine it.



You're solving two 5-letter words that differ by just one letter, like SHORE and SCORE. You get seven guesses in total, and every guess gives you clues toward both words. Once you find one, can you work out its twin?



It's free to play in your browser, with no sign-in needed:

[https://wordtwiq.dfrankiej.com](https://wordtwiq.dfrankiej.com)



If you have a few minutes, try one game and let me know what you think of the gameplay, difficulty or design, or anything that feels confusing. Thanks!
